cohort: 1000 newborns at Combined Military Hospital Abbottabad, Pakistan
finding: The frequency of hearing loss in the cohort was found to be 13 per 1000 newborns, with no significant associations found between hearing loss and mode of delivery or parental consanguinity.
mod_finding: Of the 13 infants with hearing loss, 9 (69%) were born through SVD and 4 (31%) through C-section.
